insurer_note: Jubilee Life Insurance Kenya individual life pages. Direct fetch of the listing page jubileeinsurance.com/ke/life-individual/ was blocked by the session allowlist; product list was taken from the navigation links shown on the Smart Scholar page. No pure term-life, funeral or Faida (standalone) pages appeared in that list, so none are included; a 'Faida' product may exist but was not verified. Exclusions mostly not published online.

products.name: Smart Scholar
products.summary: Education savings plan with life cover; pays Sum Assured plus bonuses at maturity and keeps the plan running if the parent dies or is permanently disabled.
products.target_client: Parents and guardians (incl. single parents, young families) funding primary, secondary or university costs
products.how_it_works: Choose term and premium; maturity pays 100% of Sum Assured plus annual and terminal bonuses. On death or permanent disability Jubilee pays the remaining premiums and the policy continues.
key_features: Annual bonuses up to 4% of Sum Assured per year
Terminal bonus equal to 100% of annual bonuses
50% of Sum Assured paid immediately on death
riders_options: Child Accident Hospitalisation up to KES 250,000
Last Expense KES 100,000 within 48 hours (child covered KES 50,000)
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: From KES 2,000 monthly or KES 100,000 single premium; minimum Sum Assured KES 200,000
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual or single premium
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Not stated on the page; medical tests required for Sum Assured of KES 7.5m and above (page shows a typo) and age 54+
channels_or_distinct_points: Apply via callback request, SMS 'Smart Scholar' to 24464, or branch
Documents: ID, KRA PIN, application form
analysis_selling_points: Low KES 2,000 entry; bonus-based with premium continuation if parent dies
analysis_watch_outs: Bonuses are 'up to' 4% and not guaranteed
Exclusions not published; need brochure
Max entry age 50 narrower than other Jubilee savings plans

products.name: Faida Elimu Insurance Plan
products.summary: Investment-linked education fund with professional management, partial withdrawals after 2 years and premium waiver on death or disability.
products.target_client: Parents of children aged 0 to 18 wanting disciplined education savings with protection
products.how_it_works: Build a managed education fund over 5 to 15 years; top-ups allowed; maturity pays 100% of fund value.
key_features: Partial withdrawals after 2 years; full withdrawal possible
Future premiums waived on death or permanent disability
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: KES 5,000 monthly or KES 100,000 lump sum; sum assured not stated
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly or yearly plus top-ups
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Not stated on the page (check brochure)
channels_or_distinct_points: Callback form, SMS 'Elimu' to 24464, or branch
Launched around April 2026 per press coverage
analysis_selling_points: Fund-value based, flexible and liquid vs guaranteed-bonus plans
Wide entry age 18 to 65 suits grandparents/guardians
analysis_watch_outs: Returns not guaranteed (investment-linked); no return figures published
Higher KES 5,000 entry than Smart Scholar
Charges and exclusions not on page
products.source_note: Fetched Jubilee product page; launch timing from search result headlines only.

products.name: Smart Save
products.summary: Savings plan with life cover for goals such as home, education, business or car; bonuses plus Sum Assured paid at maturity or death.
products.target_client: Individuals 18 to 65 wanting disciplined savings with protection
products.how_it_works: Regular contributions build the fund; annual bonuses may be declared; maturity and death both pay Sum Assured plus bonuses and terminal bonus. Surrender value after 24 months.
key_features: Annual bonus up to 4% of Sum Assured
Policy loan up to 90% of surrender value
benefits: Death benefit 100% Sum Assured plus bonuses
Maturity benefit 100% Sum Assured plus bonuses
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: From KES 2,000 monthly or KES 100,000 single; minimum Sum Assured KES 200,000
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, annual or single premium
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Not stated on the page; medical reports may be required at age 54+ or Sum Assured above KES 7.5m
channels_or_distinct_points: Callback, SMS 'Smart Save' to 24464, or branch
analysis_selling_points: Low entry, flexible term, comprehensive rider menu
Death pays full Sum Assured plus bonuses
analysis_watch_outs: Bonus 'up to' 4%, not guaranteed
Surrender value only after 24 months
Exclusions not published

products.name: Fanaka Investment Plan
products.summary: Fixed-premium savings plan with life cover where you receive the Sum Assured plus accrued bonus at policy end.
products.target_client: Individuals saving for a home, car, ceremonies or business seed capital
products.how_it_works: Pay fixed premiums for a chosen 5 to 20 year term; sum assured and premiums fixed at the outset.
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Minimum premium not stated; minimum Sum Assured KES 350,000, no maximum
channels_or_distinct_points: Page links to a separate 'How to Make Payments' section
analysis_selling_points: Fixed terms give certainty for a dated goal
Overlaps with Smart Save for conversation about alternatives
analysis_watch_outs: Minimum premium and payment methods not published
Higher minimum sum assured (KES 350,000) than Smart Save (KES 200,000)
Bonus basis not disclosed

products.name: Faida Maisha Insurance Plan
products.summary: Universal-style plan combining lifelong cover with investment-linked savings, flexible contributions and partial withdrawals.
products.target_client: Business owners, professionals, parents/providers and high earners
products.how_it_works: Regular or one-off contributions are invested while the policy provides life cover; on death beneficiaries get life cover, fund value and last expense benefit.
key_features: Partial withdrawals after 2 years, up to 10% annually during premium term
benefits: Cover from KES 100,000 to KES 200 million
Full access to funds after maturity
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: KES 5,000 monthly or KES 100,000 lump sum; sum assured KES 100,000 to KES 200 million
analysis_selling_points: Very high sum assured ceiling suits estate/high-net-worth cases
analysis_watch_outs: Charges and mortality costs not published
Investment-linked returns not guaranteed
Riders and exclusions not on page

products.name: Faida Elite Plan
products.summary: Universal life product with flexible premiums, professionally managed investment and a death benefit.
products.target_client: Savers wanting growth with protection (no specific segment stated)
products.how_it_works: Premiums are invested; top-ups any time; limited partial withdrawals after 2 years.
key_features: Up to three partial withdrawals after 2 years, max 15% of fund value
Full withdrawal from year 1 subject to charges
Annual fund management fee and mortality charge
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: KES 5,000 monthly or KES 100,000 single; cover KES 100,000 to 1,000,000
products.payment_options: Yearly, half-yearly, quarterly, monthly or single
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Not stated on the page. Surrender charges (regular premium): 15% years 1-12, 10% 13-24, 5% 25-36, 0% after; single premium: 10%, 5%, 2.5%, 0%. KES 600 per partial withdrawal. Page shows overlapping year-36 boundary
analysis_selling_points: Entry up to age 80 is unusually wide
analysis_watch_outs: Long surrender-charge schedule penalises early exit
Cover cap of KES 1m is modest
Term not published

products.name: Triplex
products.summary: Life policy paying survival benefits in thirds of the term (25% at 1/3, 25% at 2/3, 50% plus bonuses at end).
products.target_client: People with long-term goals (e.g. house) who may need funds earlier
products.how_it_works: Fixed premiums; 25% of Sum Assured paid at one-third and two-thirds of term, remainder plus accrued bonuses at end; death pays full Sum Assured plus bonuses regardless of payouts already made.
key_features: Pay by stop order, direct deposit or M-PESA
products.min_premium_or_sum_assured: Minimum Sum Assured KES 200,000; minimum premium not stated
products.payment_options: Salary stop order, direct deposit, M-PESA
products.waiting_periods_or_exclusions: Not stated on the page. Surrender value after 3 full years' premiums
analysis_selling_points: Money-back style liquidity points suit milestone planning
Death benefit not reduced by survival payouts
analysis_watch_outs: Long minimum term of 12 years
Minimum premium not published
Exclusions not published

products.name: Personal Pension Plan
products.summary: Retirement savings plan building a fund in an interest-bearing account with a 4% guaranteed rate.
products.target_client: People preparing for retirement, especially early starters
products.how_it_works: Periodic contributions earn interest; statement annually; at retirement draw income up to 15% a year while balance stays invested.
key_features: Pay via M-PESA, cheque, standing order, stop order or cash
benefits: Tax relief on contributions up to KES 240,000 a year
products.payment_options: M-PESA, cheque, standing order, salary stop order, cash
analysis_selling_points: Guaranteed capital appeals to risk-averse savers
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age, minimum and term not published
Guaranteed 4% is modest vs inflation

products.name: Personal Provident Fund
products.summary: Long-term retirement savings in an interest-bearing fund; interest declared yearly and compounded daily, guaranteed 4%.
products.target_client: People planning retirement, especially early starters
products.how_it_works: Periodic contributions; flexibility to increase, decrease or suspend.
benefits: Tax exemption on contributions up to KES 240,000 a year
analysis_watch_outs: Entry age, term, minimum and payment options not published

products.name: Income Drawdown
products.summary: Post-retirement fund giving flexible income with control over drawdown amounts.
products.target_client: Retirees over 50 with accumulated retirement benefits
products.how_it_works: Choose draw amount (taxable) monthly to annually up to 15% of balance; top-ups and reinvestment allowed; inheritance possible.
benefits: Yearly bonus income tied to performance
products.payment_options: Not applicable (draw frequency monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, annual)
analysis_selling_points: Allows estate to pass to heirs
analysis_watch_outs: Recommended KES 1m minimum
Drawdowns are taxable
Fees not published

products.name: Single Premium Immediate Annuity
products.summary: Lump sum converts into guaranteed lifetime income, fixed or variable.
products.target_client: Retirees or windfall recipients wanting lifetime income
products.how_it_works: After single premium, payments come at chosen frequency; fixed or variable (linked to mutual fund performance).
benefits: Tax-free for retirees over 65 per page
products.payment_options: Monthly, quarterly, biannual or annual payouts
analysis_watch_outs: Minimum premium and annuity rates not published
Page's tax claim should be verified
